ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 20% high-intensity (light) patches localized along the inferior medial border and scattered mottled regions near the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (dark) circular clusters are mapped across the distal 30% of both lobes. A contiguous high-intensity (white) region is mapped along the bottom-center leading edge, extending slightly into the medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an acute angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth is clearly defined against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the posterior boundary; peak amplitudes of 5-15 pixels are observed, with higher frequency and jaggedness on the distal segments of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe trailing edges follow a generally convex parabolic curve from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular low-intensity clusters (dark spots) concentrated near the outer margins and tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of at least four parallel dark linear marks (rake marks) visible on the medial-to-distal region of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and ragged margins on both distal tips; prominent parallel rake marks on the dorsal surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme 'shredded' or 'fringed' appearance of the trailing edge extremities, particularly at the right distal tip, indicating chronic trauma or colonization.
